evals.name: explicit assistant
evals.prompt: 健言小天使，我下期不知道被排到講員還是講評，先告訴我需要確認什麼，確定後再帶我準備。
evals.expected_output: Ask only the role-disambiguating question, then route to exactly one specialist instead of triggering all skills.
expectations: 先確認講員或講評這個會改變流程的關鍵差異
不得在角色未定時同時產生講稿與講評稿

evals.name: multi role plan
evals.prompt: Use 健言小天使 to organize next session: chair run sheet, two speakers' preparation, evaluator observation sheets and timer table. Collect shared facts once.
evals.expected_output: Create a shared session brief and route each deliverable to the minimum relevant specialist skills in dependency order.
expectations: 共同日期題目名單與順序只收集一次
每個角色工作均交給正確專用Skill

evals.name: ambiguous evaluation
evals.prompt: 下週輪到我評，幫我準備一下，但我還不知道是評一位還是總評整場。
evals.expected_output: Ask one concise question distinguishing individual evaluation from whole-session general evaluation before routing.
expectations: 只問評一位或評整場這個必要問題
未確認前不得自行選擇講評或總評

evals.name: conflicting timing
evals.prompt: Someone says the second bell is 2:59 and 3:30, but our image and later correction disagree. Coordinate the right Taipei TM rule before preparing all role sheets.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the shared rule through timer operations and propagate the confirmed 2:59 and 3:00 rings consistently.
expectations: 採用使用者確認的2分59秒與3分00秒各一響
修正結果須一致傳遞給所有相關角色

evals.name: direct speaker neighbor
evals.prompt: 我是講員，題目和故事都確定了，直接幫我完成三分鐘稿與不帶稿骨架。
evals.expected_output: Invoke taipei-tm-speaker-coach directly because the single role and deliverable are already explicit.
expectations: 不需要入口總管再次盤問已確定角色

evals.name: generic speech
evals.prompt: 幫我準備公司尾牙的三分鐘致詞，這跟健言社TM無關。
evals.expected_output: Do not apply Taipei TM routing or its society-specific timing and four-no rules.
expectations: 不得把一般公司致詞誤判成健言社任務

evals.name: international
evals.prompt: Coordinate my international Toastmasters meeting with Table Topics, Grammarian and Ah-Counter.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this router is Taipei TM specific and must not invent unsupported international roles.
expectations: 不得分流至本套台北市健言社專用角色
